title: LinkedIn Authority Score™
tagline: Does your LinkedIn profile attract clients — or quietly turn them away?
description: 12 questions that score your LinkedIn profile on headline, visuals, story, content and trust — and show you exactly what to fix to attract clients.

categories.label: Profile Foundations
categories.recommendation: Rewrite your headline around the client outcome you deliver ('I help X achieve Y') and add a branded banner with a clear promise — these two changes alone transform first impressions.

categories.label: About Section & CTA
categories.recommendation: Rewrite your About section to speak to your ideal client's problem, prove you solve it, and end with ONE clear call-to-action with a link.

categories.label: Content & Visibility
categories.recommendation: Post twice a week about client problems and results — use AI to draft posts from your real client stories so consistency doesn't depend on inspiration.

categories.label: Authority & Trust
categories.recommendation: Collect 5 recommendations from past clients this month and add your best results to your Featured section — social proof does your selling for you.

questions.text: What does your LinkedIn headline say?

options.label: Just my job title and company
It describes what I do for clients
A clear 'I help X achieve Y' promise with proof

questions.text: What's in your banner image (the big image behind your photo)?

options.label: Branded banner with my promise and a call-to-action

questions.text: How professional is your profile photo?

options.label: No photo, or a very casual one
Decent but dated or low quality

questions.text: Who is your About section written for?

options.label: It's empty or just a bio/resume
Mostly about me and my career
A mix of my story and client value
Written to my ideal client: their problem, my solution, proof

questions.text: Does your profile tell people what to do next (book a call, visit a link, message you)?

options.label: Clear CTA in headline, About and Featured sections

questions.text: Are you using the Featured section (pinned links, lead magnets, results)?

options.label: Yes, with a link or two
Yes — lead magnet, best content and booking link

questions.text: How often do you post on LinkedIn?

options.label: Never, or a few times a year

questions.text: What do you mostly post about?

options.label: Client problems, results and lessons — content that attracts buyers

questions.text: Do you engage (comment meaningfully) with your ideal clients' posts?

options.label: Some comments when I have time
Yes — deliberate daily engagement with target clients

questions.text: How many recommendations do you have from clients?
Does your profile show specific results or numbers you've achieved for clients?

options.label: Concrete numbers and named outcomes throughout

questions.text: When prospects Google your name, does your LinkedIn make you look like the obvious expert?

options.label: Yes — it closes deals before the first call

bands.label: Invisible — Prospects can't find a reason to trust you
bands.summary: Right now your LinkedIn is a missed opportunity: prospects who check you out (and they do — before almost every deal) find nothing that says 'this is the person to hire.' The fix is mostly writing, not time — and AI makes it fast.
actionPlan: Week 1: Rewrite your headline: 'I help [ideal client] achieve [outcome]'.
Week 1: Upload a professional photo and a simple branded banner (Canva, 30 minutes).
Week 2: Rewrite your About section for your ideal client, ending with a clear CTA.
Week 2: Add your booking link and best proof to the Featured section.
Week 3: Ask 5 past clients for recommendations (send them a draft to make it easy).
Week 3: Draft 8 posts from real client stories using AI — schedule 2 per week.
Week 4: Spend 15 minutes a day commenting on ideal clients' posts.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to systemize content creation permanently.

bands.label: Present but not Persuasive
bands.summary: Your profile exists and looks respectable — but it reads like a resume, not a client magnet. You're one strong rewrite and a consistent posting rhythm away from LinkedIn actually generating conversations.
actionPlan: Week 1: Upgrade your headline from title to client promise.
Week 1: Fix your weakest area from the score breakdown below.
Week 2: Restructure your About section: their problem → your solution → proof → CTA.
Week 2: Refresh the Featured section with a lead magnet and booking link.
Week 3: Build a 2-post-per-week rhythm using AI drafts from client stories.
Week 3: Request recommendations from your 3 best clients.
Week 4: Start 15 minutes of daily strategic commenting.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to automate your content pipeline.

bands.label: Authority — Now scale the machine
bands.summary: Your LinkedIn presence is genuinely strong — clear positioning, proof and activity. The next level is leverage: systemized content, deliberate outreach and converting profile visitors into booked calls automatically.
actionPlan: Week 1: Audit your last 10 posts — double down on the 2 formats that got real engagement.
Week 1: Add a direct booking link everywhere a prospect might look.
Week 2: Build an AI-assisted content system: 1 hour to draft a month of posts.
Week 2: Create one flagship piece (guide or case study) for the Featured section.
Week 3: Start deliberate outreach: 5 warm, personalized conversations per week.
Week 3: Track profile views → conversations → calls in a simple sheet.
Week 4: Ask your best clients for results-focused recommendations.
Week 4: Book an AI Audit to connect LinkedIn into your full lead pipeline.
